Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet for Metro Empire, a Sydney transit strategy game for smart 10–14-year-olds. Flat vector look like Mini Metro, bold friendly geometric silhouettes, saturated solid fills, consistent thick #1E2430 ink strokes and rounded corners. Palette exclusively red #E63946, blue #1D7FE0, green #2BA84A, gold #F4A300, neutral #9AA3AD, ink #1E2430, and very light grey #F1F3F5. Background everywhere is EXACT solid magenta #FF00FF, no texture or variation. Never use magenta within sprites. Crisp outer boundaries. No gradients, shading, textures, 3D, perspective, shadows, glow, watermarks, grids, frames, borders, labels or captions. All sprites completely separate and self-contained, wide empty magenta margins and gutters, no clipping. Only explicitly requested logo text allowed.
Asset type: logo sprite sheet, landscape high resolution 3072 x 1536. Exactly TWO sprites. Top area: a very wide full logo occupying at least 2000 pixels of width, bold custom geometric uppercase lettering reading exactly "METRO EMPIRE" (M E T R O, E M P I R E). Ink lettering combined with a compact elegant coloured metro line motif with station dots and subtle Sydney Harbour Bridge arch. Wide horizontal wordmark, readable strong playful typography. Lower area: ONE matching square icon-only logo, no letters or text, same metro line motif and bridge arch, centred with large empty space all round, no enclosing frame. Make the two marks feel unmistakably from the same brand. Logo station dots use light grey instead of white. No other objects or text.

Asset type: high resolution 3072 x 2048 train sprite sheet. Exactly FIFTEEN complete train sprites in FIVE rows and THREE columns with generous blank magenta gutters, no visible grid. EVERY TRAIN is seen STRICTLY FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE, orthographic roof plan, horizontal with front nose pointing RIGHT. No side windows, no side elevation, no visible wheels, no tracks. Roof panels, small vents, ink coupling joints. CONSISTENT roof width / vertical height for every train, thick uniform ink outline, coloured body roof with light grey simple roof details.
Each row has three train types: LEFT one Sydney double-deck suburban train with EXACTLY FOUR connected carriages and rounded ends. CENTRE one Sydney Metro train with EXACTLY THREE connected sleek carriages and a streamlined RIGHT nose. RIGHT one light rail tram with EXACTLY TWO connected short carriages. Carriages joined with short ink flexible connectors, whole train is ONE complete sprite; magenta gaps never separate carriages completely.
Rows colour order top to bottom: neutral light grey with grey #9AA3AD trim; RED #E63946; BLUE #1D7FE0; GREEN #2BA84A; GOLD #F4A300. Each colour repeats exactly the same geometry across its row's three types. All trains at least 500px long, roof height at least 140px. Suburban 4-car trains longer than metro 3-car trains, metro longer than tram 2-car trains; identical carriage scaling across colour variants. Allocate column widths accordingly. Absolutely no lettering or symbols resembling writing.
Flat pure solid colour planes like clean SVG art. No highlights, texture, gradients, bevels, shading or shadows.
prompts.prompt-icons:
Use case: stylized-concept. Metro Empire production game icon sprite sheet with a genuinely TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, high resolution 2048 x 2048. EXACTLY SIXTEEN isolated icons arranged in a spacious four-by-four layout, no visible grid. Flat vector look like Mini Metro, bold friendly geometric silhouettes, thick consistent #1E2430 ink strokes, rounded corners, pure solid fills. Each icon occupies an equal roughly 320px square footprint with generous empty gutters. Transparent cutouts, including all negative space. No background colour, tiles, frames, borders, labels, text, numbers, watermarks, gradients, textures, shading, shadows, glow, bevel or 3D.
Each icon uses ONLY ink #1E2430 and at most ONE accent colour chosen from red #E63946, blue #1D7FE0, green #2BA84A, gold #F4A300. No white or grey fill; open space is TRANSPARENT.
Row 1 left to right: (1) Sydney Opera House simplified iconic overlapping sails, ink and blue; (2) Parramatta three office towers, ink and blue; (3) Airport top-down plane silhouette, ink only; (4) Macquarie Park simple tech office building with small circuit detail, ink and green.
Row 2: (5) Liverpool town-centre clock tower, ink and gold, clock hands but NO numerals; (6) Station a simple thick ink circle with transparent centre; (7) Interchange station two concentric ink circles with transparent gaps and centre; (8) Harbour crossing simplified Sydney Harbour Bridge arch and two pylons, ink only.
Row 3: (9) Stadium event an oval stadium bowl, ink and blue; (10) Money round gold coin outlined in ink with a small ink train-front symbol INSIDE, no letters; (11) Strike raised hand silhouette, ink and red; (12) Track works one simple traffic cone, ink and gold.
Row 4: (13) Capture timer a stopwatch, ink and blue, hands no numerals; (14) Toll a lowered boom gate on support, ink and red; (15) Pause two chunky vertical ink bars; (16) Play/resume one chunky right-pointing ink triangle.
Every icon complete and independent. Every listed item exactly once. Consistent scale and visual weight.
